bindings.query: SELECT CAST(g.FieldValueConversionGroupSystemName AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomFieldValueConversionGroup g WHERE (g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT FieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductCategoryField) OR g.FieldValueConversionGroupId IN (SELECT ProductFieldValueConversionGroupId FROM EcomProductField)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomFieldValueConversion c WHERE c.FieldValueConversionParentGroupId = g.FieldValueConversionGroupId AND c.FieldValueConversionId = g.FieldValueConversionGroupBaseUnitId))
